scripts.env:sync: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('.env')) { fs.copyFileSync('.env', 'apps/web/.env.local'); fs.copyFileSync('.env', 'apps/api/.env'); }"
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm env:sync && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @kalemny/web --filter @kalemny/api dev
scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm env:sync && corepack pnpm --filter @kalemny/web dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm env:sync && corepack pnpm --filter @kalemny/api dev
scripts.build: corepack pnpm prisma:generate && corepack pnpm -r build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm prisma:generate && corepack pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint apps/api/src packages/contracts/src vitest.config.ts && corepack pnpm --filter @kalemny/web lint
